preconditions.description: The number of elements in the set S is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each element in the set S is between 1 and 200,000, inclusive.
The elements in the set S are distinct.

postconditions.description: The largest non-negative integer x is the output.

postconditions.expression: output_permutation is a permutation of integers from 0 to 2^output_x - 1
postconditions.description: The output permutation consists of 2^output_x integers.

postconditions.expression: for all i in range(2^output_x - 1): output_permutation[i] ^ output_permutation[i + 1] in S
postconditions.description: The bitwise xor of any two consecutive elements in the output permutation is an element in S.
